visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair lies on a bed, looking directly at her smartphone camera. She is wearing a white oversized T-shirt with red lettering. The lighting is soft and indoor, casting a warm glow on her face as she speaks casually. (2) The scene shifts to the woman sitting up in a bedroom or living room environment. She uses hand gestures to emphasize her words. Several graphical overlays of chat messages and a grid of video thumbnails appear on the bottom half of the screen. (3) A screenshot of a health report is shown with the number '31' circled in red, followed by an emoji of a shocked face. The background is a white document with various technical data fields. (4) The woman is shown in a kitchen setting. She drinks a bright green celery juice from a glass. She then prepares a mixture of cucumbers, kiwis, and apples using a grey juicing machine on a wooden countertop. (5) In a hallway, the woman stands wearing a white tank top and black athletic shorts, showing her midriff. She poses to display her physical progress. A large text overlay indicates a reduction in body fat percentage from 31 to 28. (6) Close-up shots of three skincare bottles with droppers are presented on a white surface. The woman applies a clear serum to her face and neck, massaging it into her skin. The background is a white-tiled bathroom or vanity area. (7) The woman holds the three product bottles in front of her face while smiling at the camera. Festive graphics and promotional text regarding a 100-yuan discount appear across the frame as she concludes her presentation.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a bedroom with a soft bed, a clean white kitchen with a wooden counter, a hallway with a white door, and a bright white studio setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with an energetic female voice narrating over an upbeat, major-mode electronic pop track with a clear 4/4 drum beat. The vocal is crisp and well-mixed, with a high arousal level and friendly tone. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the transition to the kitchen. Sounds of liquid splashing into a glass and the rhythmic percussive thuds of a knife on a wooden cutting board are clearly audible under the speech. (3) A distinct finger-snap SFX and a 'ding' chime trigger a scene shift. The background music maintains its tempo, while the female speaker's pitch rises with excitement as she announces her body fat results. (4) During the skincare product display, subtle metallic and glass clinking sounds are heard as droppers are moved. The speech density increases as she explains product benefits, perfectly synchronized with the bright synth melodies. (5) A final 'pop' and digital UI sound effect mark the appearance of discount vouchers. The female voice concludes with a confident and authoritative yet welcoming sign-off as the music reaches its peak intensity and fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Personal Hook -> Problem (Body Fat) -> Action (Diet/Juicing) -> Result -> Commercial Solution (Skincare) -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote ASDceuticals skincare products by first building trust through the creator's personal health journey. By sharing her success in reducing body fat and improving her lifestyle, she creates a relatable context for introducing skin maintenance as the next step in self-improvement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly introduces the brand name, demonstrates the product application, and provides specific discount information.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-density social media editing with frequent text overlays and SFX optimized for short-form video engagement.
